rows.name: Portsoy
rows.description: Bright and red leading lights on pier

rows.name: Cullen Harbour
rows.description: A fixed bright lt., occasionally, on end of pier

rows.name: Findochty
rows.description: Fix. br. lt. on pier; occasional red lt. on shore

rows.name: Buckie Harbours
rows.description: One on North pier-head, and one on shore. Leading lights in line S.E. ½ S. A red tide light on middle jetty

rows.name: Port Gordon, East pier
rows.description: Lts., outer red, inner br. (August 1 to April 1)

rows.name: Elgin and Lossiemouth
rows.description: One fixed green light on South pier-head

rows.name: COVESEA SKERRIES
rows.description: Stone tower, 118 ft. high, on Craig Head. Lt. is red to East, in Spey Bay, from S.E. by E. ½ E. to the land. The rest is bright

rows.name: Burghead
rows.description: Seen to S.W. only. Bright or red lt. on North pier; red light on South pier; red light on end of timber spur

rows.name: Nairn
rows.description: On pier; red between N.W. by W. and N.E. by E., and bright to East and green to West of this sector. (Sept. 1 to May 1)

rows.name: Fort Rose
rows.description: Fixed red light on pier. (Aug. 1 to May 1)

rows.name: Chanonry Point
rows.description: Stone tower, 42 ft. high

rows.name: Inverness
rows.description: Two red leading lights on Thornbush Pier

rows.name: Cromarty Point
rows.description: Stone tower, 42 ft. high

rows.name: TARBET NESS
rows.description: White tower, 134 ft. high, 430 yds. from extr. Light visible 2½ min., eclipsed ½ min. Within Moray Frith, from S. ½ W. to S.W. ½ W., light is continuous (fixed)

rows.name: Little Ferry
rows.description: Two fix. br. lts., occasionally; N. side of entr.

rows.name: Wick or Pulteney Town
rows.character: 1. One fixed red light 2. One fixed green light 3. Two fixed bright lts.
rows.description: 1. Lighthouse on extremity of North pier 2. Lt.-ho. W. of outer harb. Open N. of red lt. clears ruined breakwater on S. shore of bay 3. At outer end of works, South pier extension When entrance is dangerous, bright lights not shown, but a green light, or three black balls, shown on South head look-out

rows.name: Lybster Harbour
rows.description: Stone lighthouse on extremity of West pier

rows.name: NOSS HEAD
rows.description: Bright light seaward; in Sinclair Bay, from N.E. by N. to W. by N. ¾ N., the light is red

rows.name: Keiss
rows.description: One fixed bright light on pier end

rows.name: PENTLAND SKERRIES
rows.description: Two stone towers, 118 and 88 ft. high, N. by E. ¾ E. and S. by W. ¾ W., 100 ft. apart

rows.name: DUNNET HEAD
rows.description: Stone tower, 66 ft. high, on the northernmost point of Scotland

rows.name: Little Holburn Head
rows.description: White tower, 55 ft. high. Light bright towards Pentland Firth; red West of S.S.W., in Scrabster Road

rows.name: CANTICK
rows.description: White brick tower, 73 feet high, on the head, S.E. extremity of Walls Island

rows.name: HOY SOUND, Gremsa Id.
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright or red light 2. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: 1. Stone tower, 108 ft. high, on N.E. point; high light red to seaward, but bright betw. N.W. by N. ¾ N. and N.E. by E. ¾ E. A ray of lt. towards E. entr. of Hoy Sound, betw. S.E. by S. ½ S. & S. ¾ E. 2. Low lt. on N.W. point, 2,237 yds. to N.W. ¾ W. Vis. to N. betw. E. ½ S. and W. ½ N. Lts. in line lead in mid-chanl. from the westwd.

rows.name: Stromness
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights on pier, for steamers

rows.name: Kirkwall
rows.description: On the new pier-head. (Aug. 1 to April 30)

rows.name: AUSKERRY
rows.description: White brick tower, 112 ft. high, on South part of island, in Stronza Firth
